title: Fleet slice daily sampler — dashboard CSV export
content:

Quick observations:
- dev-scratch pools show very low average util and high preemptions; these are short-lived user jobs with avg_batch_size < 4 which drives low slot utilization.
- Dedicated pools (dedicated-ml-*) consistently above 80% average util with high p95; KV/prefix cache usage seems correlated with better p50->p95 compression.
- prod-high slices run near target but show increased p95 on peak days (2026-11-05) indicating tail congestion; correlate with prefix cache hit dips for some slices.
- Spot/burst slices show frequent spill_events and schedule latency spikes; scheduling tweaks over last 48h reduced preemptions in some slices.

Actionable next steps (owner tags):
- Temp throttle for dev-scratch during 14:00-18:00 UTC (owner: Marcus Diaz) — ticket INFRA-1842.
- Warm-cache prefetch trial for prod-high slices during nightly ramp (owner: Lina Chen) — run A/B across slice-101 vs slice-102.
- Allocate +2 GPUs from dedicated-ml-2 to eu-west-1 prod-high overnight (owner: Priya Raman) — assess cost/latency tradeoff.
- Add automonitor rule: if p95 > 95% and prefix_cache_hit_pct < 60% for 3h then open incident (owner: SRE rotation).

Notes to reviewers: this CSV snapshot was exported from the sampler job (sampler-v2) fed by the per-slice PromQL rollup. Values are approximate (shingled sampling) and intended for triage rather than billing reconciliation. For raw telemetry, reference the Grafana panel in linked_artifacts.
